verdict.rationale: LanceDB is open-source (Apache-2.0 licensed on GitHub) and its embedded/local architecture with pluggable disk-first storage (local NVMe, S3-compatible object stores) means the core product can be run and hosted entirely by the user without any hosted service dependency. Community evidence corroborates real-world self-hosted/embedded use (e.g., embedded in an Electron app). missing for 10: no dedicated self-hosting/deployment guide, no Docker/Kubernetes deployment docs, and no independent write-up specifically confirming a full self-hosted production deployment path (enterprise features like OAuth/SOC2 appear tied to a hosted Enterprise offering).
